title: Key-value file store whose compaction keeps only live keys
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag that compact() trusts the in-memory map instead of re-reading the file. The map is built by replaying the file at open and updated on every fsynced append through the same _apply path, so it is exactly the live-key set; the check verifies state is unchanged across reopen both before and after compaction.
